policy.target_conflict_rule: A repeated non-null target_path is valid only when every conflicting action is MERGE_REFERENCE or REWRITE_REFERENCE.
policy.duplicate_rule: A private blob byte-identical to the public blob at the same path is EXCLUDE_DUPLICATE_PUBLIC and is never copied twice.
policy.secrets_rule: The validator handles tree metadata only and never prints source blob contents or secret values.
